resources.string: Point LEVI at the machine serving your LEVI web client, then come back here.
Load failed: %1$s. Check the server URL and that your machine is reachable.
Enter a full URL starting with http:// or https:// (empty clears it).

On your computer, run the LEVI web client (in the repo: cd web && npm run dev), find your computer\'s LAN address, and enter it here as http://<lan-ip>:8080. Away from home, expose it with a tunnel (e.g. cloudflared) and use the https:// tunnel URL. Full steps: docs/ANDROID_APP.md
